facts.fact: Socrates 不正面接 Meno 之战，而示范奴隶男孩也能 inquire；随后二人放下 virtue 定义、回到 virtue 可否教之问——可推断 Meno 没有认输（thrown in the towel）；Socrates 不放弃他：steadfast、unaffected、ready to resume

Plato 请我们分辨 woundedness 与 confusion：起初 Meno pride stung——骂 Socrates magician/torpedo fish；后来 regroup、自觉被领入理解的黑洞；woundedness 中我们 feel lost，impartiality/open-mindedness/inquisitiveness 三力被暂时 suspend——未到能 inquire 之位；confusion=对「我们不知却以为知」的 keen awareness——actually calls forth 或 joins by 这些美德；奇异的是我们被无知之认 energized——被召去进一步 inquire、盼 confusion yield to greater clarity；perplexed≠take personally

非混淆案例：问已知事；说胡话（我们知其无义——非混淆或非 existential）；说太小声（请大声）；看熟悉物直呼其名；根本没想到问；走向曾到之地知往哪去；许多 utterances（statements/expressions/exclamations/invitations/promises）不 admit existential confusion；low-grade idle doubts 或 indifferences 亦不生 confusion：Denver 到 Omaha 的 doubt 缺 salience——不 care 答案；physiology 无知但 unbothered/unmoved/unperturbed——我知道我不知此题
facts.anchor: don’t entertain the possibility of being confused

facts.fact: existential confusion=对最要紧之事的某种 not-knowing——我深深在乎的那类事；表述：「I'm aware now that I don't know how to lead my life」「I see in this instant that I'm clueless with regard to what it's all about」「As we inquire further, I recognize that I don't know what to do with myself」；不知 way out/way forward；或不知 good life 之义、不知何标准使生活算 good/fulfilling；对 it's all about 无从 get purchase——连 it 与 it all 指什么都无从说

existential confusion 中我 feel implicated、staked to 某种知——当下没有的关于自己的知；其标志=mumbling、repeating myself、circling about、stumbling 而放不下那似乎答不了的问题；Stumbling 表明我已找到 matter of existential weight；confusion 之居所=lodged between a gripping question 与 an absent answer

S1=Recognition of Hubris：我承认（或默认）本以为自己知道关于自己或生活的某件要紧事——直到你以此问将我置于问下；S2=Insight into Ignorance：我其实不知合适的答案会是什么样；S3=Desire to Inquire Further：现在我想知道合适答案会是什么；stubborn/close-minded 者拒 S1；sinking into ignorance 者停在 S2；有人接受 S1+S2 却缺 courage/patience/open-mindedness 去 explore S3——落入 despair；接受三式者 embrace existential confusion、long for clarity、eagerly embark on further inquiry

餐馆地址例：问路式 unknown 不入 existential confusion——我们都知道如何查证（Meno 悖论 irrelevant、philosophical inquiry unnecessary），且我不 care 地址是否知道——不触碰 self-knowledge；可推断：answerer's life 本身必须在问下——此即 recognition of hubris 之义；basic commitment 由 questioner 之问引出：(a) surfacing alive to me 之事——追索好答案 raises my powers、inquiry 中与命中后觉 joy；(b) exposing weighed down 之事——zeroing in on fraughtness、未答未名前压着我、diminishes my powers、觉 burdened

existential weight 的两 key：privative key=想知道我们的生活没有白过（not spent in vain）；affirmative key=想寻求并最终 fulfill 一个 worthwhile final aim——What is a—or the—worthwhile final aim, one that we can throw our weight behind?；我们只对关乎 final aims（已设或未设）的问题 existentially confused；Ultimately, we are whatever telos we embody

S2 详解：「not really know」=或 thoughtless speechless，或旧答案曾 make sense 而今不再/今觉 implausible；run through a set of possible answers、逐个 deem insufficient——No, that's not it / This is, at best, only a part of it；iterate through inventory of available answers、对每个与某些组合不满、finally run out of things to say；「I don't really know」=手上没有好答案可用、at a loss——不知做什么/如何继续
facts.anchor: run out of things to say

facts.fact: confrontation with our way of thinking：好 inquiry 迫我们面对关于 living way 的最基本 claims；明里暗里明白：回到旧思维已无可能、同时看不到真正的前路；想回头、受引诱，但有 intimation：那条路已 foreclosed；想快进，但 no light shines on a path；What now——除 courage/patience/open-mindedness（Interlude 2）外须进入 space of possibilities；第一时刻 confrontation→第二时刻 old way foreclosed→第三时刻 space of possibilities——从 how things have to be 的 space of actuality 转入 novel possibilities 可被揭示之域；生活不再须沿既定路线展开、可向多方向 fruitful——exhilarated yet cautious、bewildered yet curious

复盘：计划被掷入风中、directionless；但知何者无意义、有 fundamentally missing 之 inklings、primed to search earnest——in short, bewildered；Johnson 词典：bewildered=「lose in pathless places, to confound for want of a plain road」；bewildered 者 lost in the woods、难 get bearings；让 basic commitments 入问后失去 world 中的位置：What is of great value? To what can one assign significance? What sign points the way forward?；我的 bewilderment echo 现代世界：发达国家少有铺好的路——good life slippery and opaque、future illegible、actions subject to fumbling；认真对待 bewilderment 使我们以 honesty 面对不确定——with courage, patience, and open-mindedness
